Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Lyndhurst

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Lyndhurst. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Lyndhurst has a mix of homes, sheds and commercial buildings, and we handle roofs of every size, from a verandah to a warehouse. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Lyndhurst: What We Commonly See

Lyndhurst sits between Dandenong South and Cranbourne along the South Gippsland Highway, a mix of newer estate housing and an industrial and commercial edge. The estate homes are largely COLORBOND® steel, and there are larger metal roofs on the sheds and commercial buildings nearby. Set well inland, the wear here comes from heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms.

The jobs we are called out for most in Lyndhurst are storm and hail damage, refixing flashings and ridge capping, replacing tired guttering and downpipes, re-roofing ageing roofs, and re-sheeting larger shed and commercial roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Lyndhurst

From a family home to a warehouse, replacing a worn-out roof properly is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof and re-sheet Lyndhurst homes, sheds and commercial buildings in COLORBOND® steel, and we can also build and install flat metal roofing for low-pitch roofs and extensions.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Lyndhurst

Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, box gutters, downpipes and ridge capping on homes, sheds and commercial buildings. On larger roofs a failed box gutter or worn flashing can mean serious water damage, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Lyndhurst

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Lyndhurst Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Lyndhurst Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Lyndhurst locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Lyndhurst Roofing FAQs

Do you do commercial and industrial roofs?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, warehouses and commercial buildings, and replace box gutters and flashings on larger roofs.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Lyndhurst

We also work on roofs in nearby Lynbrook, Cranbourne West, Cranbourne North, Dandenong South, Hampton Park and Keysborough.
